This app began its life when I originally moved to the Apple ecosystem. At the time, most music players were streaming apps, and the few players that existed were not well maintained, or had a minimal amount of functionality. As a software engineer by trade, I dove into Xcode and created the first iteration of this player, over 6 years ago. This has been my daily driver ever since, and I've crafted this into the perfect music player according to my needs. All this time, it's lived on my phone as a development app, but I'm finally releasing this for the world to use.

This player comes packed with a multitude of features, many that you would expect from a dedicated music player. There are, however, some that are unique to this player:

• Plays most formats that are contained within a single file (e.g. no BIN/CUE).
• Allows song offsets to skip annoying intros.
• Global and per-song EQ (yes, each song can have its own EQ settings).
• Global and per-song pitch shifting and playback speed.
• FTP support for uploading and managing songs.

This player is highly customizable. You can customize things you may not have even considered to be customizable, such as the amount of time that must pass before the "Previous Song" button restarts the song or goes back to the previous song. You can also disable that functionality entirely, and use a gesture to restart the song instead.

I hope that this music player will help those who were in the same position as I once was in. Additionally, regarding any future updates, those will be released when I find that the music player is lacking in some other way. I am not aiming for this to contain every feature imaginable. This is a project born from a need and a passion, and will continue to exist as such. This is a free music player, so I hope this reaches those that may need it!
